message: `aria-atomic="false"` on the part sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: An error part with its `alert` and `aria-atomic="false"`. Chromium 153 takes the atomicity the role implies away (measured on 2026-10-27), and a reader then says the text that changed instead of the region (Orca reads the inserted text unless `container-atomic` is `true`, NVDA the same): a message going from `At least 3 characters` to `At least 5 characters` is announced as `5`. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
